summary: Frontend-only E2E testing for FERINFECTED landing page. All requested sections render with non-zero heights, lenis smooth-scroll navigation works via nav links, servicios shows 5 bento cards, productos spotlight updates on click, nosotros stats render, contact form shows correct sonner toasts for both empty and valid submissions. No console errors on load. Mobile toggle is present.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero headline text 'DISTRIBUCIÓN DE ELECTRÓNICA SIN FRONTERAS' is split into animated char spans; a naive textContent check may return false. Source contains correct copy — not a bug, just note for future tests.

Mobile menu toggle sits above viewport bounds on 390x844 and Playwright reports 'outside of the viewport' on force click; recommend ensuring the sticky navbar remains within viewport (position: fixed/sticky) so the toggle is reliably clickable at all scroll positions on mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All sections verified: hero=1080px, servicios=1199px, productos=902px, nosotros=899px, contacto=828px, nav=69px, footer=594px, marquee=242px, body scrollHeight=5743px. window.__lenis present; smooth scroll works (scrollY 1242 after servicios click, 4241 after contacto click). Product spotlight image URL changes on selection. Contact form toasts: empty → 'Completa tu nombre y correo para continuar.'; valid → '¡Gracias! Tu solicitud fue registrada. Te contactaremos pronto.' Zero console errors captured.
